messages:
Alex Chen: quick async standup — API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits
Alex Chen: What I did: landed the routing-policy feature flag scaffolding, added a small integration test for prefix-based routing. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4832
Alex Chen: Blockers: CI flake on the gateway e2e that times out intermittently when the canary runner hits the auth service; unclear if it's networking or stub timing.
Alex Chen: Today: follow up on the e2e flake, and start the canary rollout for the new ratepolicy config if green.
Samira Patel: @Alex thanks — I'll re-run the failing e2e job now. If it fails again I'll attach traces from the auth proxy.
Samira Patel: quick note: rotated the test KMS key for staging yesterday so some older fixtures may error.
Jamie Ortiz: What I did: reviewed infra#4832 and left comments about TTLs in the prefix cache. Small nit: prefer 30s default not 60s for our low-latency routes.
Jamie Ortiz: Blockers: waiting on the autoscale prod metrics export from infra-monitoring to validate burst settings.
Ryan Li: FYI I tweaked the rate limiter delta window to reduce head-of-line blocking. Deployed to staging, looks OK: 99.9% < 120ms on token path.
Ryan Li: Small config snippet used in staging: ```rate_policy: { default_window_ms: 500, token_limit: 120 }```
Maria Gomez: Heads-up: auth team will be rotating JWT kid values tomorrow 10:00 UTC. @Alex @Samira you might see a short spike in 401s if we don't hot-reload keys.
Alex Chen: @Maria noted. I'll add a key-refresh handler to the gateway middleware today; if we still see 401s we can fallback to long-lived service account for the canary.
Lee: ping on code review for infra#4832 — left an approve on the perf bits, still want one more :eyes: on the feature-flag toggles.
Alex Chen: @Lee thanks — addressed the toggle naming and pushed a tiny refactor.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for infra/gateway:rolling/2026-03-17T08:10Z
deploy-bot: Canary 1/5 healthy :white_check_mark: (latency 95th 98ms)
QA-bot: e2e-run-2145008901 completed — 1 test failed: auth/integration/token_refresh_test — attaching logs https://ci.redwood.local/2145008901
Samira Patel: re-ran the failing e2e with increased timeouts, it passed. Looks like a race in the test harness. Filing a flaky test ticket.
Samira Patel: ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-1027
Ryan Li: Can we add a temporary retry in the e2e harness for token refresh to reduce noise? If so I can open a small PR.
Jamie Ortiz: ok with retry for now but please add a TODO to remove it once auth key rotation is stable.
Alex Chen: Agree. I'll open the PR to add key hot-reload and the retry in e2e. Then we can proceed with canary 2/5 if QA+deploy pass.
Maria Gomez: For the JWT rotation, I will publish a post to #announcements and send an email to infra oncall 09:00 UTC.
Lee: small ask: can someone ping me when canary reaches 3/5 so I can run the rate spike test?
Alex Chen: Will do.
Alex Chen: tl;dr: PR up, addressing CI flakes, will add key hot-reload; canary running, need QA signoff then rate spike tests.
Samira Patel: thanks all — I'll update ENGPLAT-1027 with the retry PR link and e2e traces once uploaded.
